name: apxUSD
oneLiner: apxUSD is Apyx's DAT preferred-equity-backed dollar with a cash/T-Bill buffer; whitelist-only primary mint/redeem settles in USDC.
collateral: Preferred shares issued by Digital Asset Treasuries (DATs) — variable-rate, dividend-bearing preferred equity from companies holding digital assets (e.g., Strategy STRC, Strive SATA), held in excess of apxUSD outstanding, plus a cash and short-term U.S. Treasury Bill buffer (incl. USDC) for liquidity; redemptions settle in USDC, with preferred-share positions sold to USDC under stress
pegMechanism: Whitelisted primary-market mint/redeem with USDC settlement at Redemption Value; secondary liquidity and arbitrage support non-whitelisted holders, while Protocol-Owned Liquidity provides an additional stability buffer during market stress.

proofOfReserves.provider: Wolf & Company, P.C. monthly AICPA attestation opinions covering the platform's backing assets, of which apxUSD is the collateralized base token (latest report June 2026 as of 2026-08-08; the Accountable dashboard names apxUSD but runs on Apyx-deployed infrastructure and is treated as secondary)
